headline: Comet Drift GP's canyon stands up
lede: The Mode 7 desert's biggest honest gap — strata that were painted floor-tape, not walls — is closed: the canyon rim now extrudes to true vertical rock that parallaxes, hazes and occludes karts, while the certified sim and every seed-pin stay byte-identical.

notes.text: #2388 shipped: rim loops ride the sim's own escape law and rise to (rim−foot)·0.3 — wide run-off stands a taller canyon, per the Daytona banking and Laguna pinches.
Rock and karts now share one far→near sort, so the canyon occludes honestly; the ground bake keeps only the wall's cast shade; bump debris scatters inward, piling at the foot where it actually lands.
10 new cometcheck gates + 2 new mutants die (rise law zeroed, painter-merge removed); cometplay 30/30, cometsandplay 10/10, attractcheck 694, zero page errors.
Never-dry stage: COMET DRIFT GP was the shelf's weakest title (score 2). QA polish pass #2395 filed for sun-side lighting, crest faceting and crack strobing.
